notes.title: DRK-STORY - BLACK BOOK II - Devil Card
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40976168/526c64bed131a66515e126cf3a9e5e07daeda887.png[/img]
We're developing DRK-STORY - BLACK BOOK II - Devil Card.
We saw the potential of this kind of game. 
What we need are more NPCs and some kinda battle system.
I decide to add a card battle game in BLACK BOOK II.

If you want to support us, welcome to join our [b][url=https://www.patreon.com/DokuroH]Patreon[/url][/b].
There are many free games for partrons, which are not sold on steam.
Thanks!
